database_vs_cache.comparison: Database Direct Query vs Key-Value Cache
database_vs_cache.trade_offs: Requires explicit commit-then-invalidate cache hygiene, additional Redis memory footprint, and safeguards against serving stale appointment slots or inventory counts.

search_vs_debounce.comparison: Raw Keystroke Queries vs Debounced Trie Autocomplete
search_vs_debounce.trade_offs: Introduces 250ms perception delay before suggestion popup appears; Trie index requires periodic synchronization when new doctors or medicines are onboarded.

indexed_vs_non_indexed.trade_offs: Indexes consume additional storage and incur modest write overhead on insertions and updates.
